topic: why the newspaper window-cleaning hack actually works
title: The Newspaper Window Hack Isn't Magic — Here's Why It Actually Works
description: Ever wonder why the newspaper trick for cleaning windows actually works? We break down the real reason behind it -- not the myth. AI-narrated original commentary.

beats.text: Everyone says newspaper cleans windows better than paper towels. That's not actually true.
The real trick isn't the newspaper -- it's what's missing from it.
Paper towels are woven with tiny loops of fiber that shed lint on glass.
beats.broll_query: paper towel lint on glass macro

beats.text: Newsprint is pressed flat with almost no loose fiber, so it leaves nothing behind.
Any lint-free cloth works the same way -- coffee filters, microfiber, old cotton shirts.
beats.broll_query: coffee filter and microfiber cloth cleaning glass

beats.text: The ink helps too, cutting through grease better than most people expect.
The hack works. Just not for the reason it went viral.
